Subject: Request: Short-term capacity surge for inference/runtime team (3 roles)

Hi Kimberly and Laura,

Quick ask: I need approval to open and fill three immediate engineering slots on the inference/runtime roadmap to meet two commitments that are time-sensitive:

1) Datascale P1 integration (Q1 pilot) — requires low-latency KV cache changes and model routing work (customer-facing SLA).
2) Q4 internal performance push — we have a sequence-length optimization project that must ship before end of year to hit revenue targets for Dedicated.

Proposed hires (headcount request #REQ-2026-187):
- Senior Runtime Engineer (x1) — focus on KV cache + continuous batching optimizations
- Platform SRE (x1) — runbook/observability + SLA guarantees for Dedicated pools
- Staff Compiler Engineer (x1) — quantization-friendly kernels and kernel selection tooling

Summary ask: +3 FTEs as an exception to the current hiring freeze for the runtime/platform org, funded from Q4 hiring pool (we will backfill two lower-priority reqs in infra next quarter). Total incremental OTE run-rate ~ $1.2M (fully burdened). I attached a spreadsheet with comp bands, timeline, and org impact.

Timeline: ideally onboard offers week of 11/8 to start ramping in early December.

Risks if we delay: Datascale integration slips (revenue and ref case), increased token cost for Hosted customers due to non-optimized kernels, and SLA gaps on Dedicated renewals.

Can you review and either: 1) approve to submit reqs to TA and People, or 2) suggest which slot to defer?

Thanks,
Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Director, Runtime Engineering
Redwood Inference

Inline answers and band numbers (all OTE midpoints, fully burdened yearly):

- Platform SRE: Level IC4, midpoint OTE $200k/yr (fully burdened ~ $275k/yr)

Ownership: final headcount sign-off from People + Finance; I'm requesting expedited pre-approval to post and extend offers contingent on their sign-off to meet the Datascale timeline.

Marcus / Kimberly —

Appreciate the quick numbers. I support the ask in principle given the Datascale commercial upside and the SLA risk. A couple of conditions before I sign off formally:

1) Provide a one-page mutual action plan with milestone checkpoints through Jan 2027 (deliverables tied to each hire).
2) Commit to a two-week candidate sloshing strategy: TA to prioritize internal referrals and the dedicated recruiter list; offers will include modest signing bonuses (within band) rather than large premium over OTE.
3) Connor to provide a plan for backfilling the two infra contractor slots and expected timing; we need that to be visible to Finance.

If the MA Plan and the contractor backfill timeline look reasonable, I will greenlight posting the reqs and start the paperwork with People.

Laura
VP, Product Operations
